preconditions: seed remote points to canonical upstream
database backup exists when migrations are involved
steps: fetch seed and inspect changes since current pin
merge using zdiff3 and resolve by intent
preserve project identity, scope and applied migrations
run all adapter verification commands and Recipe gates
record local patches and update the manifest pin
rollback: Discard the unmerged update branch. If deployed, use the project release rollback and database recovery plan; never rewrite applied migrations.
